items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: It was Ally Ross (Al Roth?) band. And Ally was, he liked Zutty too. And he wanted Zutty.

ctx.x: And Louis. Louis hadn't even talked to Zutty about what was he going to do? He didn't know what Zutty was going to do. Because Zutty said, boy I'm going to talk to Louis. You know, because they were friends for so many years and they came here together. And I said, if Louis wanted you Zutty he'd

talk to you. I wouldn't go to see him. Oh yes, I want to talk to him. I want to see what he's going to do. Made me mad. So we went down there and that's the only way we found out for sure that Louis was through with him with Carroll Dickerson's band. And Zutty was set. Because Carnie's Inn, the girls wanted Zutty. Everybody in there wanted Zutty see but they didn't want the rest of the band. It was Ally Ross (Al Roth?) band. And Ally was, he liked Zutty too. And he wanted Zutty.
Now, did you say that Louis Russel's band was a better band than Carroll Dickerson's?
